description: Higgsfield API generates images and video from code using one API key and a prepaid dollar balance.
auth_notes: A single API key created in the console opens all models in the catalog; MCP and CLI instead use the Higgsfield account sign-in.
gate_detail: Sign up, register a payment method and fund a prepaid USD balance before requests run; no plan or subscription involved. No free tier or sandbox stated.
api_scope: Asynchronous image and video generation across the model catalog, with request status polling, webhooks, a cost estimate endpoint and Python and TypeScript SDKs.
mcp_notes: Official Higgsfield MCP connects agents to a user's higgsfield.ai account and deducts plan credits, separate from the API.
blocker_detail: Requests are paid from a prepaid USD balance that must be funded first; requests wait when the balance is empty.

evidence.quote: one API key opens every model in the API catalog, and each request is paid in US dollars from a prepaid balance.
Register a payment method and fund your balance.
Generate an API key in the console at open.higgsfield.ai .
call the REST API directly from any language with an HTTP client, sending requests to api.higgsfield.ai
receiving a webhook when the result is ready
the only official connector URL is mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp

uncertainties: No sandbox or free test environment is described.
